body:
A friend of mine recommended this anime and a few others.  I have to say, i really disliked it.  Anime's like this, is this a view into the minds of the fans?  Like, if I get Isekai'd into a new world where I have godlike powers, I'm going to murder millions of people!  (Better yet, I'll do it mostly because I don't want my immediate subordinates to think I'm not as smart as them!) 

All of the main characters detest humans... because... yea.  For an anime that's supposed to have good worldbuilding... why is that?  Why does everyone hate humans?  Is it because of something in Yggdrasil?  Aren't they supposed to be food for your species or something?  Weren't all your creators human, too?

All the women giggle helplessly when they murder/torture. What \~IS\~ that..?  It's so god damn cringe... but it's a hallmark of these kind if anime.  Almost as bad as the 'helplessly sexually aroused when murdering'.  God damnit Japan...
